hooks.command: input="$(cat)"; sid="$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"; [ -z "$sid" ] && sid="$$"; m="/tmp/cc-notified-${sid}"; if [ -f "$m" ]; then rm -f "$m"; exit 0; fi; name="$(tmux display-message -p '#S' 2>/dev/null || basename "$PWD")"; name="${name//\"/}"; osascript -e "display notification \"$name — done\" with title \"Claude Code finished\"" 2>/dev/null; afplay -v 4 /System/Library/Sounds/Submarine.aiff 2>/dev/null || true

input="$(cat)"; sid="$(printf '%s' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"; [ -z "$sid" ] && sid="$$"; touch "/tmp/cc-notified-${sid}"; name="$(tmux display-message -p '#S' 2>/dev/null || basename "$PWD")"; name="${name//\"/}"; osascript -e "display notification \"$name — needs input\" with title \"Claude Code waiting\"" 2>/dev/null; afplay -v 4 /System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff 2>/dev/null || true
